mapgen.start.label: Starting area size
mapgen.tip.absorption: Modifier of how much pollution is absorbed by trees and tiles.
mapgen.tip.attack_cost: Modifier of how much pollution is consumed to send a biter to attack.
mapgen.tip.destroy_factor: Controls how fast evolution increases due to destroying enemy spawners. Each spawner destroyed raises evolution by the number times 0.00001: 200 means 0.002.
mapgen.tip.diffusion: The amount of pollution diffused into neighboring chunks per second.
mapgen.tip.enemy_size: The size of each enemy base.
mapgen.tip.evolution: Controls whether enemy evolution is enabled.
mapgen.tip.expansion: This can turn off/on the expansion logic as a whole.
mapgen.tip.group_factor: How much the evolution factor affects the size of enemy expansion parties.
mapgen.tip.max_cooldown: The maximum time between enemy expansions being sent out.
mapgen.tip.max_distance: The maximum distance enemies will look to expand from other enemy bases.
mapgen.tip.max_group: The maximum size of an enemy expansion party modified by the current evolution level.
mapgen.tip.min_cooldown: The minimum time between enemy expansions being sent out.
mapgen.tip.min_distance: The minimum distance enemies will look to expand from other enemy bases.
mapgen.tip.min_group: The minimum size of an enemy expansion party modified by the current evolution level.
mapgen.tip.per_tree: Trees have 4 different progressive stages toward being destroyed by pollution. This value specifies how much pollution is absorbed when moving to a more damaged stage.
mapgen.tip.pollution_factor: Controls how fast evolution increases due to producing pollution. Each unit of pollution produced raises evolution by the number times 0.0000001: 9 means 0.0000009.
mapgen.tip.price: How much all research costs, as a whole number: 1 is normal, 2 is double.
mapgen.tip.recipe_difficulty: Expensive makes many recipes need more ingredients.
mapgen.tip.research_queue: When players can line up several research projects to run one after another.
mapgen.tip.spawning: Rate at which asteroids spawn in space.
mapgen.tip.spoil_rate: Rate at which spoilable items spoil.
mapgen.tip.starting_area: The size of the area without enemy bases around the player.
mapgen.tip.technology_difficulty: Expensive makes research cost more science packs.
mapgen.tip.time_factor: Controls how fast evolution increases over time. Each second, evolution rises by the number times 0.0000001: 40 means 0.000004.
mapgen.tip.tree_damage: Trees have 4 different progressive stages toward being destroyed by pollution. Any pollution above this amount starts the process of moving a tree toward a more damaged stage.
mapgen.width.label: Width
